verdict.rationale: The evidence shows only indirect noise-reduction signals: Supply Chain flags findings as reachable, Secrets prioritizes validated (actively in use) secrets, and Semgrep Assistant post-processes findings to cut noise by about 20%. None of it documents filtering or gating CI builds on severity or confidence, so this is glancing support at best. Missing for 10: a documented severity/confidence filter flag or setting, CI build-blocking configuration based on severity or confidence, and independent or hands-on corroboration of gating behavior.
